## CPython 3.13’s Free-Threaded Mode and Extension Support

CPython 3.13 introduced experimental free threading as a configuration that can run with the GIL disabled. In that mode, an extension’s support declaration matters when the extension is imported: if it lacks an explicit declaration, CPython warns and enables the GIL.

How an extension makes that declaration depends on whether it uses multi-phase or single-phase initialization. In either case, declaring support communicates compatibility with free-threaded mode. It does not make the extension’s code thread-safe; that is a separate responsibility for extension authors.
